contexts.text: Wine of scortation (, etc.) = the adulterated truths of faith, of which drunkenness is predicated.

Girls who have been enticed into scortations, and persuaded that there is no evil in it, and are otherwise well-disposed... have an instructor... who chastises them whenever, in thought, they break out into such wantonness... Thus are they vastated... (Continued. See Harlot.)
Ratiocination from scientifics about spiritual and celestial things, is called scortation (or whoredom.)
The falsification and adulteration of the doctrine of faith... is scortation. Illustrated.
The adulterations of good, and the falsifications of truth, are described in the Word by adulteries, and scortations. (Continued. See Adultery.) AC 2729:end.
That what is perverted of the Church is called scortation. Illustrated.
Many kinds of adulteries and scortations, and still more numerous species, are treated of in the Word.
This ratiocination is called, passim, scortation with the sons of Egypt, and with the sons of Asshur.
The scortations of the sons of Israel with the Midianitish women... have a like signification; for by scortations were represented the falsifications of truth.
To scortate (done by the daughter of a priest) () = to profane good.
(Such) are very much delighted with the company of those who have been harlots.
Adulterations of good are meant by adulteries; and falsifications of truth, by scortations, in the Word. References, Illustrated. AC 4552:end. AC 6348:2. AC 6432:5.
The Jews lyingly said that they were not born from scortation.
Scortation, everywhere in the Word. = the falsification of truth.

It is said that Judah took Shuah, by which it is tacitly indicated that it was not marriage, but scortation, and thus that the sons from her were born from scortation; neither is the conjunction of evil with falsity anything else.
A life of evil is signified by your daughters scortate (); and a doctrine of falsity from which is a life of evil, by your daughters-in-law commit adultery.
Such things are called scortations.
The spirit of scortation () = a life of falsity from evil.

Tamar... hath scortated () = that it is false that anything conjugial intervenes... To scortate = falsity... The Jewish nation... perceived the Internal of the Church no otherwise than as a harlot; and its preaching and life according thereto, no otherwise than as scortation. Explained.
She is with child to scortations () = that thence anything can be produced... Scortation = the falsity from their religiosity.
Scortations () = falsified truths.
This (increase of good and truth) cannot take place before, except as from scortation; but the good from this is spurious, and also the truth...
To scortate, and love meretricious hire () = to falsify truths, and to love the things falsified.
The scortations of the harlot () = the falsifications themselves. ( = the falsified good of truth. AC 7297:2.) ( = perversions of truth. AC 9188:5.)

The reason a married girl was to be stoned if virginities were not found with her... () was that by scortation was signified the falsification of truth, thus the destruction of it... For spiritual scortation is the falsification of truth.
Hence it is that the falsification of truth is scortation; and the perversion of good is adulteration, in the internal sense. Illustrated.
In these passages everyone can see that by scortations are meant spiritual scortations, that is, perversions of the good, and falsifications of the truth, which are of the Church.
Dogs, enchanters, and fornicators () = those who falsify the good and truth of faith; who are said to be without when they are outside Heaven or the Church.
The hire of a harlot = the falsified truths of faith. That scortation = the falsification of the truth of faith. References.
To scortate in Egypt () = to falsify truths through scientifics.
To scortate = to pervert truths through applications to falsities or evils.
To scortate with the sons of Egypt great in flesh () = to falsify the truths of the Church through scientifics which are from the natural man only, thus through sensuous scientifics.

Lest they go a whoring after their gods () = the consequent falsities of evil... For to go a whoring (or scortate) = to be conjoined illegitimately; and the gods of the nations = the falsities of evil.

To scortate is often mentioned in the Word, and by it is signified illegitimate conjunction with truth; and by to commit adultery, illegitimate conjunction with good. Hence by to scortate is signified the falsification of truth... (which) is effected in three ways. Explained.

All these kinds of falsifications are called, in the Word, scortations and harlotries; for, as by marriage is meant a lawful conjunction, which is that of good and truth, illegitimate conjunctions are meant by scortations. Illustrated.
And their daughters go a whoring alter their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods () = thus the profanation of good and truth; (for) to scortate = illegitimate conjunction.
The like is signified by the scortation of Ephraim; for scortation = the falsification of the understanding of the Word, that is, of its genuine truth.
Scortations = adulterations and falsifications of the Word. Illustrated.
When a fornicator sees a harlot...
Adulterations of good are described in the Word by adulteries; and falsifications of truth, by scortations.

Balaam taught... to commit fornication () = hypocritical works, by which the worship of God is... adulterated... To commit fornication = to adulterate and pervert worship. ( = to falsify truths. AE 141.)

(Jezebel) teacheth and seduceth My servants to commit fornication () = from which the truths of the Word are falsified... To commit fornication = to adulterate and falsify the Word. The reason this is signified by to scortate, is that in each thing of the Word is a marriage of good and truth, and this marriage is broken when good is separated and is taken away from truth. It is from this that to scortate = to adulterate the goods and falsify the truths of the Word; and, as this is spiritual scortation, those who, from their Own reason, have falsified the Word, after death... become fornicators... AE 161.
That scortations = adulterations of the good, and falsifications of the truth, in the Word. Illustrated.

I gave her time that she should repent of her fornication, and she repented not () = that those who have confirmed themselves in that doctrine (of faith alone) do not recede although they see things contrary to it in the Word. To recede from scortation, here = to recede from falsifying the Word. AE 162.
It is forbidden under a penalty to scortate promiscuously. (See Harlot.)
Scortation = the falsification of truth.
They repented not of their... fornications (). Explained. ( = did not actually turn away from falsifying truth. AE 590.)

The wine of the anger of her fornication () = profanations of the Word, and adulterations of the good and truth of the Church... Scortation = the falsification of truth; and the anger of scortation = adulteration and profanation.
Those meant by the dragon... appeared at a distance like satyrs... and those in the upper seats, like fornicators and harlots. Described. TCR 388.

With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication () = that it has adulterated the truths and goods of the Church which are from the Word. To scortate = to falsify and adulterate truths. AR 767.
And murderers, and fornicators, etc. () = all who make nothing of the precepts of the decalogue...
Without are... fornicators, etc. () = that no one is received into the New Jerusalem who makes the precepts of the decalogue of no account...
In Heaven they are quite ignorant what scortation is: that there is such a thing, or that it is possible. The Angels are cold all over the body at unchaste or extra-conjugial love...
(Thus) the love of the sex... being roving and unlimited, is scortatory.
In an infernal prison, where to both promiscuous scortation is interdicted under a penalty.
Those who have been celibates (here), and have quite alienated their minds from marriage... if they are natural, become fornicators.
They have this eminent potency from a total renunciation of scortation.
He could not utter the word scortation, because the chastity of their Heaven resisted it.
If fornicators invade us, they are cast out into the fatuous lights of the south.
This was from polygamous love, which is... scortatory.
We asked. What is your religion as to scortations? The crowd murmured. What have you to do here with scortations? Scortations are scortations: let him who is innocent cast the first stone.
That the chastity of marriage comes forth through a total renunciation of scortations, from religion. Explained.
Consequently, in proportion as scortation is renounced, the chastity of marriage enters.
Therefore, when the heat of conjugial love removes and rejects the heat of scortatory love, conjugial love begins to warm pleasantly...
The reason this renunciation of scortations must take place from religion, is that... if a natural man renounces scortations, still his spirit does not renounce them...
The sphere opposite to it is called meretricious with such women; and scortatory with such men.
Conjugial love believed to be one with scortatory love, except that the latter is illicit by law (a cause of cold). Explained.
Nothing stores up in itself conjugial cold more than scortatory love; and, as it passes into cold, it may be called conjugial cold itself.
By application to uses (a man) exterminates the wild insanities of scortatory lust.
The universals of Hell are these three loves: the love of dominating... the love of possessing... and scortatory love.
The pleasures on the part of (such) a husband are to be called those of scortatory love.

The pleasures of scortatory love descend to the lowest Hell, and on the way, and there, conjoin themselves with the pleasures of all infernal loves, and thus enter into their unhappiness, which consists in a distress of all the delights of the heart. The reason is that the pleasures of this love are also those of insanity.
The love of proprium... so long as it prevails, remains scortatory.
Evil regarding the sex, which is in the natural man, is scortation; but as this is ruinous to society, in place of scortation there has been induced its likeness, which is called polygamy.
There are also scortatory marriages, in which, by mutual consent, the license of lust is given to both.
The Pleasures of Insanity concerning Scortatory Love. Title.
On the opposition of scortatory love and conjugial love. Chapter.

By scortatory love is not meant the fornicatory love which precedes marriage; nor that which follows it after the death of the consort; nor concubinage... nor the mild kinds of adultery; nor the grievous kinds of which a man actually repents... But by the scortatory love opposite to conjugial love is here meant the love of adultery, when it is such that adultery is not held to be sin... but allowable and according to reason. This scortatory love not only makes conjugial love the same as itself; but also ruins, destroys, and at last nauseates it.
That the quality of scortatory love is not known unless that of conjugial love is known. Explained.
That scortatory love is opposite to conjugial love. Explained. CL 426, Explained. CL 427, Explained. CL 429, Explained.
He who is devoid of charity, is dissolute to all the lasciviousnesses of scortatory love.
Scortatory love, regarded in itself, is natural love.
That the uncleanness of Hell is from scortatory love... Explained.

The appearances in Hell under which the lascivious delights of scortatory love are presented, are ordure and filth; the odours... are stenches and stinks; and the fornis of beasts and birds... are swine, serpents, and the birds called ochim and ziim.
Those in the immodest and obscene delights of scortatory love summon to themselves like (Spirits) from Hell.
(The sons of Israel were commanded to cover their excrement) because... these unclean things correspond to the lasciviousnesses of scortations.
That scortatory love makes a man more and more not a man... Explained.
That there is a spiritual sphere of scortatory love... Explained.
That the sphere of scortatory love ascends from Hell. Explained.

That the two spheres (of scortatory and of conjugial love) meet each other in the world, but do not conjoin themselves together. That between these two spheres there is an equilibrium, in which is man. That man can turn himself to whichever sphere he pleases; but that in proportion as he turns himself to the one, he turns himself away from the other. And that each sphere carries delights with it. Explained.

The ultimate plane in which the delights of both loves cease... is the same; and hence scortatory amatory things, and conjugial ones, in the extremes, are perceived as alike, although in internals they are altogether unlike...
That the delights of scortatory love begin from the flesh; and are of the flesh even in the spirit... Explained.
That the delights of scortatory love are pleasures of insanity... Explained.
With these (three degrees of natural men) scortatory love, and its insanities and pleasures, are of like degrees.
The quality of the delights of scortatory love, elucidated by comparisons.
Two Angels... said... Omit these (meditations about scortatory love) because they are nothing. I replied. This love... is not nothing, because it exists.
I rejoiced because it had been granted me to speak With Angels of such innocence that they were quite ignorant of what scortation is.
See Conjugial Love.
Those who die as infants... are quite ignorant what scortation is, or that it is possible.
Under Fornication, see this reference.

That (concubinage conjointly with a wife) is scortation, by which the Conjugial... is destroyed. Explained... It is a scortation more opposite to conjugial love than common scortation, which is called simple adultery. Explained... In polygamic scortation there is what is analogous to conjugial love...
I heard a certain (novitiate) Spirit boasting of his scortations...

In his internal sight, in which scortation played the first part, he was not rational; (and the heavenly scenery) did not appear before his internal sight, which was scortatory, and turned heavenly into infernal things, seeing only the opposites. Described.
As the evil of scortation defiles the internals of the mind more than any other evil...
Impotence is the lot which awaits those who glory from the potency of scortation.

I have heard in the Spiritual World that some married men have the lust of scortating with virgins; some with harlots; some with wives; some with those of noble family; and some with those not of noble family. Described.
Nine hundred out of a thousand (Christians) say... What is marriage but allowable scortation?
That by the lust of varieties is meant the utterly dissolute lust of scortation. Explained.
On the correspondence of scortations with the violation of spiritual marriage. Chapter.
On the imputation of each love, scortatory, and conjugial. Chapter.
That thus is scortatory love imputed to each one. Explained.

The like is the case with scortations, whether they be fornications, pellicacies, concubinages, or adulteries; for these are imputed to everyone, not according to the deeds themselves, but according to the state of mind in the deeds.
No inference is to be drawn... from the appearances of scortations, as to whether anyone has conjugial love, or not. Therefore Judge not, lest ye be condemned.
On fornicators who allure virgins to scortations with deceit.
When spiritual Angels conversed about the things written by me not being true... I seemed to myself to scortate, and even to commit adultery, in my sleep.
I have perceived... sometimes, a sphere of scortation, which sphere was around... It was from those who had persuaded themselves that faith alone saves...

There were very many who are to be called fornicators and adulterers, who have said that they acknowledge true doctrine, yet have not done so with the heart... (Other kinds of scortations and adulteries, enumerated.)

(Cities there where there is much scortation and adultery, almost as in Sodom.) The cause is that in the world such things are everywhere regarded as of no moment; and also because they place all the Church in doctrine alone; and also because they do not care whether doctrinal things are false or true; and falsifications of doctrine are scortations, and adulterations of good are adulteries.

When those on a higher mountain... say that doctrine is false and evil, those lower down want to scortate and commit adultery with the women of others, whom they say are in the falsity or evil of doctrine; (this being) a representative which corresponds.
See Last Judgment.
In those Hells which are under judges... they are allowed to conjoin with themselves some woman... but are not allowed to... scortate promiscuously.

There are Hells full of harlots, into which novitiates come, and scortate to satiety. Penalties accrue from various shocking diseases; and on this account they desist. Sunt ibi societates turpes, ubi conveniunt scoria et adulteri: coetus sunt ubi scorta quavis node sibi eligunt marcs; non coetus sunt ubi mares eligunt scorta. Scorta ibi possunt per phantasias se facere pulchras.
Under Adultery, see this reference. AE 1010:4.
To scortate = to imbue falsities, and also to falsify truths. Illustrated.
Scortations, in the spiritual sense, or spiritual scortations, are nothing else than falsifications of truth.

That scortations and adulteries involve such things, has been evident from much experience... The spheres from Spirits who had been such, manifest them: from the presence of Spirits who have confirmed falsities with themselves, and have applied truths from the sense of the letter to confirm them, there exhales a sphere of abominable scortation. Such spheres correspond to all the forbidden degrees (), with a difference according to the application of the truths to the falsities, and according to the conjunction of the falsities with the evils, especially with the evils which spring from the love of self.
To scortate = to make doctrine and worship from falsities.
To scortate = to imbue Falsities. AE 242:15.
Scortations and adulteries = falsities and the derivative evils.

Conjunctions of truth with merely natural affections, correspond to scortations and adulteries of various kinds... It is conjunctions of the Truths of the Word with the love of self and the love of the world which correspond to them.
To scortate in Egypt = to falsify truths through the scientifics of the natural man; and to falsify truths there, is to turn holy things into magical ones, as the Egyptians did. AE 576:8.
To scortate with the daughters of Moab = to adulterate the goods of the Church.
On sacerdotal scortation. General article.
